description:
THE DESIGN IS docs/scope-exit-destroy-design.md -- read it; this task is its owner.  Stage 1 (filehandles) is #2006(b), brief ready (s494h).
MEASURED s495 (~/pcl-agent-scratch/s495/destroy/): d1.pl = perl's ten DESTROY-timing shapes (11 calls; PCL 0); guard-bench.lisp = an unwind-protect costs +4.3 ns per guarded scope entry, +3.2 ns when `return`'s throw crosses it, +2 ns per `go :next` crossing, and a depth/flag test with NO unwind-protect is FREE -- hence the owner stack released at the exits that already exist (after the sub's catch, loop top, block end, eval handler); destroy-census.pl = all of core has 46 `sub DESTROY`, 16 empty, the rest restore state / close+flush / unlink / delete a registry entry.
ORDER: Stage 0 first (needs no brief beyond the doc's section 4 + a guard file; `cl/` => full sweep + op/ companion leg; ref.t rows 63-64, grep.t 69-76 and bless.t's lifetime rows are the acceptance set to re-measure -- some need Stage 2).  Stage 2 only after the RETENTION BATTERY exists (about 60 shapes, perl the oracle, each asserting DESTROY has NOT run while a keeper is alive): Fable writes the battery's shape list, an agent builds.  USER has NOT yet said whether to schedule either stage -- ASK; the doc's section 6 is the recommendation.
NOT TO RETRY: GC finalizers as the DESTROY trigger (SBCL runs them after the object is gone; no $self), a header/storage split for resurrection (taxes every object access), a reference count on containers (the whole memory model).

=== USER RULING (s495, 2026-09-22) ===
"`DESTROY` doesn't seem to be worth the trouble? :-) :-(  If stage 0 is cheap, please put that in the todo list."  => Stage 2 is PARKED: four to six agent-days plus a 60-shape retention battery, with a silent-wrong risk (an unmarked retention route = DESTROY on a live object), for a feature 30 core modules use.  Do NOT schedule without a new USER word.  What would re-open it: a module people actually need (DBI is the obvious one -- its handles rely on DESTROY for disconnect/finish) turning out to be unusable with exit-time DESTROY only.  Stage 0 = task #2371 (todo list).
subject: PARKED (USER s495: "DESTROY doesn't seem to be worth the trouble"): Stage 2 of docs/scope-exit-destroy-design.md -- scope-owned objects (static owner licence + owner stack + escape marks).  The design and its measurements are kept here; Stage 0 is #2371, Stage 1 is #2006(b)
